notes: 10Web needs no company data — email, first name, last name, password were enough. The AI first presents a plan that has to be approved before generation starts; that approval step blocked the build until it was clicked. The result is a WordPress site on a 10web.cloud subdomain, and the generated content itself is solid: all three services with prices, a contact section, studio text. But the front page was never assigned, so the shared URL is empty, and the contact form is inert. Both are setup failures a normal user would hit too. Scored against all eight landing criteria after the spec was aligned to the same eight-point scale as the booking tests. Added 2026-11-05: the free trial has since ended. my.10web.io logs in but every website route redirects to /upgrade-plan, and app.10web.io no longer resolves, so the 10web.cloud URL from the run cannot be retrieved. The screenshots in /artifacts remain the only evidence of the published page.
